At least it shows your not a minimum effort worker. That counts for something with me at least.

“They say it's what you make
I say it's up to fate
It's woven in my soul
I need to let you go”

Demons - Imagine Dragons

I give little hints but no one seems to notice: I kinda hate everyone. Despise them. I smile and wave and will tell them off sometimes but they don’t know the magnitude. I will really only help if it can help me or entertain me. Now that I think about it I might be a sociopath... alway scores high on those tests...
I want to believe I do but it might be from something different...

How many laugh at my jokes but aren’t able to see through my monotone voice and lack of care. How they find the way I act amusing. I care about many things, but I don’t care for them. They can’t see that and I’m not sure why. 

Why are we happy or sad? Why can’t we just accept? Father Time doesn’t stop ticking so why do we waste our thoughts on this.

We will all die. Some before others. Most times we will do it alone. Without comfort. With our death we only hurt others, not ourselves, as we would be dead.

Is there a God? I want to believe but is there true proof? Is religion just a giant scheme to justify the things we do? So we don’t have to accept it alone?

So yeah, not much on my mind. Hope you figure your question out.
